page.notes: Right margin notes are italic and small; the note marks in the text are not printed with braces. Doubtful readings: the Greek words in the first and second lines and in the note at "Sententiæ in bonorum" are uncertain. "nosse" and "mag[?]tris" are uncertain readings. The text "magnitudinis" was not used because it does not match the scan. The word "consultatione" at the end of the line "Monet. n. illi in cofultatio" is cut off in the scan. Cropped notes at the top of the right margin and the line-end hyphens in "ele-", "cópara-", "prę-", "cópa-", "ma-", "habe-", "id-", "at-", "expe-", "con-" are kept as printed.
